svg.title: Y0. Which data feed which analysis
svg.text: Y0. Which jurisdictions feed which analysis
Cells: contracts used (reasons: amendments with informative text; documents: amendment documents read). Dash: not usable, with the reason at right.
Amendment rows only from FY2023+ reports
Original vs. current + version count; no dates
Timing: contracts with dated amendments inside a known term. Sizes: contracts with two or more dated positive dollar changes.
Cooperative-sales data (Texas DIR, Washington DES, Delaware) record spending, not amendments, and feed the network figures instead.
